nku-fine-arts-center.mobility.1.text: NKU says all performance venues have accessible seating; a house manager or usher can help. Guests who need special seating because of a medical condition should contact the box office at least 48 hours ahead; availability depends on the performance venue.
quote: All performance venues have handicap accessible seating . Please see a House Manager or Usher for assistance.

Guests requiring special seating consideration due to a medical condition should contact the Box Office to make advance arrangements with a minimum of 48 hours notice. Availability depends on the performance venue.
nku-fine-arts-center.mobility.1.reason: Retained accessible seating and notice guidance; corrected availability wording to performance venue, as the source states.

nku-fine-arts-center.mobility.2.text: Lots D and I are designated for SOTA events including music concerts, theatre/dance productions and gallery receptions. For student recitals, Henry Theatre productions and general gallery visits, the event policy instead directs visitors to the Welcome Center Garage. No food or drink is permitted in Fine Arts Center performance venues.
quote: Parking Lots D and I have been designated for NKU SOTA events, including music concerts, theatre & dance productions, and art gallery receptions.
If attending student recitals, productions in The Henry Theatre, or general art gallery visits, guests should use the Welcome Center Garage .
No food or drinks are permitted in any performance venue in the Fine Arts Center.
nku-fine-arts-center.mobility.2.reason: Added the event-policy exceptions to Lots D/I so student recitals, Henry productions and general gallery visits are not given the wrong parking direction.
